text:
sarah: Deploybot flagged a p95 latency surge on /embeddings-prod around 12:43. deploybot suggests rollback. I'm proposing a manual pullback to v2.7.1 for 30m while we triage — thoughts?

deploybot: Auto-rollback recommendation: revert traffic to model v2.7.1 (confidence 0.88). Awaiting operator confirm within 3m. Metrics: p95 ↑ 320ms, kvcache miss rate ↑ 18%.

raj: +1 to manual pullback. I can confirm traces show kv cache miss spike after kernel q8 flag enabled in v2.9.0. tagging @emma oncall.

emma: oncall. agree with manual. runbook: 1) shift traffic to v2.7.1 2) pin that version 3) notify customers 4) start investigation ticket. I'll execute the shift and post logs.

sarah: command to use:
```
redwoodctl traffic shift --env prod --from v2.9.0 --to v2.7.1 --pct 100 --reason "kvcache regression"
```

emma: running the shift now — sending to deploy system.

deploybot: Action accepted: traffic shift requested by emma. job_id=jb-33721. ETA ~45s.

emma: job jb-33721: HTTP 202 accepted. monitoring progress...

emma: shift completed: 100% traffic to v2.7.1 in 40s. p95 back down to baseline ~120ms. kvcache miss rate returning to normal.

raj: great. I'll prepare a short customer blurb and patch release notes. Draft comms: "We're temporarily reverting to a prior model version due to an observed latency regression after a recent kernel flag rollout. No customer data was exposed. We're investigating and expect to restore the newer model after fixes; ETA 30-60m."

ops-bot: Status update posted to #statuspage and customers via queued email template "prod-latency-rollback-2026-".

sarah: leaving a pin on v2.7.1 and holding autoscale/auto-rollforward for 1h. Opening ticket INF-5421 for root-cause triage (kvcache + q8 path).

emma: noted. I'll disable the q8 kernel flag on staging and reproduce. If we get a clean repro, we'll create a patch branch and schedule a hotfix canary.

sarah: assign follow-up: INF-5421 -> raj (investigation), emma (replicate), sarah (customer comms).

emma: closing this thread for the immediate pullback — reopen if any regressions recur. :thumbsup:

sarah: thanks everyone. I'll update release notes and post a short postmortem draft once we have root cause.
